channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Sebastian Telfair | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Sebastian Telfair from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Isaiah Whitehead on Lance Stephenson, Sebastian Telfair
item.description:
Anthony Puccio:Isaiah Whitehead on Sebastian Telfair & Lance Stephenson:

“I talk to those guys everyday. Just about what to do, what not to do. They help me out a lot.”

Isaiah Whitehead on Lance Stephenson, Sebastian Telfair, Jun 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @APOOCH.

item.title: Sam Presti on Sebastian Telfair
item.description:
“We are pleased to have the opportunity to welcome Sebastian to the Thunder organization and Oklahoma City community,”

Sam Presti on Sebastian Telfair, Jul 15, 2014. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: PJ Tucker on Sebastian Telfair
item.description:
“Bassy (Telfair) works so hard on guards to turn them over. When you see a guy working like that, you can’t do anything but work as hard to match his energy. It’s a monkey-see, monkey-do thing.”

PJ Tucker on Sebastian Telfair, Dec 18, 2012. Source: Arizona Republic.
